data.name: SeasonInfo
data.value: The season is worked out from the days played plus the season day offset on the Weather tab. Every season lasts the same number of days: 5 by default, 10 for Long and 90 for Realistic. The year runs Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Example: day 36 with offset 5 on 5 day seasons is season 8, which is spring. Picking a season only moves the offset, by whole seasons, one back or two forward at most. Going back to the loaded season restores the loaded offset. The day count never changes
